continuity: Won Myunghoon gave Taekyung Yeti's Necklace as a personal gift and told him not to give it to anyone else.
Yeti's Necklace activates the Wind of the Snowfield effect and causes its possessor to become a target of dragonkin monsters.
The raid party has left Manticore's Jungle and entered a wasteland after half a day of travel.
The Star Guild defeated several Trolls by preventing their regeneration with fire and ice after attacking their heads and hearts.
A Wyvern identified as a Named Monster killed six of the seven scouts, confirming that the raid is taking place inside an A-Rank Mutated Gate.
Taekyung increasingly suspects that Won's polished, friendly public manner conceals a disturbing or unfamiliar side.
plot: Team Leader Choi examines Yeti's Necklace and complains that such a beautiful, sophisticated item is in limited supply. Won Myunghoon refuses to take it back, explaining that he values human bonds more than possessions, then reveals that the necklace is a gift for Taekyung and tells him not to give it to anyone else. After Taekyung equips it, the Item Window reveals that it marks its possessor as a target of dragonkin monsters regardless of species.

After half a day of travel, the group leaves Manticore's Jungle and enters a wasteland. The Star Guild members fight Trolls, exploiting their vulnerability to attacks on the head and heart and to fire or ice before regeneration can occur. Taekyung notices the contrast between Won's polished warmth and his private irritation at the smell of burning Troll flesh, then teases him about reports that he visits a department store five times a week as a VVIP. Won denies the report and becomes visibly uncomfortable.

Team Leader 1 returns from scouting for the missing Wyvern, deathly pale and covered in blood. Seven people had gone out, but only he returned: a single Wyvern killed the other six despite their use of concealment magic. He identifies it as a Named Monster and reveals that the group is inside an A-Rank Mutated Gate, leaving everyone in suffocating silence.

active_continuity: One Step Back granted Taekyung two level-ups and 20 Bonus Points.
Taekyung opened his Conception and Governor Vessels after consuming three Scorching Yang Qi elixirs.
Taekyung is publicly recognized as Jeok Cheongang's Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox lineage.
Jin Mukyung remains secluded in the training hall and has not returned to Heaven's Gate Temple.
The Jin Family received an invitation to the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Seong Jinho is staying at Taekyung's new family home after losing his housing deposit to Kim Jong-su.
Taekyung is an A-Rank Hunter and became nationally famous as the Tollgate Hero after the tollgate rescue and KPS interview.
The tollgate Gate released ten B-rank ogres, which Taekyung defeated before collecting their valuable parts.
The Peace Guild House has extensive magical communication, observation, and alarm systems, and its website has begun recruiting members.
The media frenzy exposed Taekyung's family's personal information, leaving him burdened by the hero label.
Won Myunghoon is a thirty-nine-year-old A-rank Hunter, former ranker and celebrity entertainer, and CEO of the Star Guild in Incheon.
Won survived the Myeongdong Station Mutated Gate Catastrophe eight years earlier, where Do Minsu and around thirty others died; he was tried and cleared.
Taekyung and Won have a friendly hyung-and-younger-brother relationship, but Taekyung declined Won's Star Guild and entertainment-agency proposals.
Taekyung and Team Leader Choi cleared The Lycanthrope's Black Forest after Taekyung killed its Silver-Mane Lycanthrope boss.
A false report claimed Taekyung would transfer to the Star Guild; Won and the outlet issued corrections.
The joint Peace Guild-Star Guild raid was redirected from Manticore's Jungle to The Black Wyvern's Nest.
Won killed the Lv. 97 Green Wyvern alone, so Taekyung received no EXP; Won lent him Yeti's Necklace to attract a stronger monster.
Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone, and Im Kkeokjeong was among the survivors he had rescued during an earlier E-Rank Gate attack.
Won has now given Yeti's Necklace to Taekyung, and a Named Monster Wyvern has killed six scouts inside the A-Rank Mutated Gate.
open_questions: What are the rewards for the Conception Vessel Opening Achievement and the rare Achievement earned after completing the Conception and Governor Vessels Quest?
Will Jin Mukyung return to Heaven's Gate Temple before the appointed deadline?
What event does Jeok Cheongang believe may occur sooner than expected, and why must he endure for several more years?
What is the true condition of the absent Martial God?
Will Taekyung attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet, and what exactly was the answer that changed the three men's expressions?
What are the Reward and Failure conditions of the Gate Suppression Quest?
How will the Gate near Hwang Cheol Soo's tollgate ultimately be contained, and what further monsters may emerge?
What is the identity and full threat of the Named Monster Wyvern, and how will the remaining raid members survive the Mutated Gate?
